frontend_constraints.evidence: Full planning bundle emitted with README, architecture, design, components, motion, content, pages, and execution contract.
Home page contains eight sections; all primary routes include at least five sections; supporting routes include compact but complete supporting structures.
ThemeSwitcher is declared in shared surfaces and component specs.
MobileBottomNav is declared with explicit five-route tab coverage.
AuthModal and fallback auth routes are declared in site inventory, component specs, and execution contract.
Light and dark theme token sets are present in design-system.tokens.json and normalized in the execution contract.
Footer attribution contract is present and linked to content keys.
Primary navigation and mobile navigation route sets are explicitly declared.
Visual differentiation map assigns distinct signatures and pair-wise deltas for medium or high latitude routes.
Interaction matrix covers call-first, quote, FAQ, theme, auth, and mobile navigation behavior.
Content library and locale JSON provide publish-ready draft copy across shared and route-specific surfaces.
All executable routes in the planner appear in page briefs and in the runtime contract route plans.
runtime_build_plan.routes exactly matches runtime_composition.routePlans route coverage.
Visual reference pack defines hero composition, mobile composition, and asset rules.
Trust-led local-service conversion patterns are maintained across home, emergency, commercial, contact, and quote routes.
Execution contract includes runtime design tokens, content payloads, navigation surfaces, and release gates.
Planning remains deterministically blocked for execution because the brief is still DRAFT, preventing premature implementation handoff.

accessibility_constraints.evidence: Every route brief includes landmark and heading outline guidance.
ThemeSwitcher, quote form, FAQ, auth modal, and navigation all include keyboard interaction notes.
Hero contrast and trust-chip contrast are explicitly planned in the design system and page briefs.
Reduced-motion behavior is declared across motion system, pages, and modal interactions.
Mobile parity is enforced; no core conversion requires hover.
Visible focus expectations are declared for buttons, form fields, cards, and dialog flows.
Auth modal includes focus trap and focus return requirements.
Quote form and auth form validation announce errors and preserve values.
FAQ disclosure behavior includes keyboard-safe patterns and readable dense layouts.
Contact and emergency routes preserve non-network-dependent phone paths for fallback accessibility.
Social icon content includes aria labels for each platform.
Header, footer, and mobile navigation all include contrast and interaction acceptance criteria.
